summary: Check prefers-reduced-motion before calling reel.play() in the IntersectionObserver callback. If reduced motion is enabled, the video stays paused on intersection; the manual button handler is unchanged so users can still choose to play.

replacements.search: const vio = new IntersectionObserver(([en]) => { if (en.isIntersecting) reel.play().catch(() => {}); else reel.pause(); }, { threshold: 0.3 });
replacements.replacement: const vio = new IntersectionObserver(([en]) => { if (en.isIntersecting) { if (!matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) reel.play().catch(() => {}); } else reel.pause(); }, { threshold: 0.3 });
